package.name: rosorin_pro_sim_description
package.description: Simulation URDF of the Hiwonder ROSOrin Pro used by the Isaac Sim digital twin (RosOrinPro-IsaacSim): Hiwonder rosorin_description (Mecanum Pro, SCLIDAR/COIN-D6) + split mecanum wheels and rollers, realistic masses and servo/motor limits. Install it on the ROS side so RViz / MoveIt can resolve the package:// mesh paths of /robot_description published by the simulator.
